title: DuckDB 1.4.2 native artifact lock manifest
$comment: Domain validation MUST perform the cross-field, archive-content, binary-inspection, workflow-constant, and release-attestation checks documented in native/README.md.

toolVersion.$comment: Numeric or semver-like only; arbitrary prose is forbidden.

normalizedRelativePosixPath.$comment: A normalized relative POSIX path: no absolute or drive path, backslash, NUL, empty segment, dot segment, dot-dot segment, or traversal.

assets.$comment: The exact final release asset set: five payloads, fifteen companions, assets.lock.json, and SHA256SUMS.

sha256sumsEntries.$comment: Exact SHA256SUMS filename coverage, excluding SHA256SUMS itself.

installPath.$comment: Domain validation correlates the target prefix and suffix to path.

sbom.$comment: Domain validation compares describes and source to the archive and top-level commits and inspects the SPDX document.

provenance.$comment: Domain validation resolves sourceRef to top-level sourceCommit and compares every source/material commit and subject to top-level values and the archive.

sbomAttestation.$comment: Domain validation binds subject to the archive and predicate to the sibling SPDX document.
